shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular slab
script arranged in horizontal bands or columns
justification: The only real correspondence is that both are flat slabs bearing low-relief writing organised into regular rows of repeated sign-blocks, a very generic feature. A shows a large figural scene, an eagle-headed winged anthropomorphic figure holding a bucket and cone between stylised plants, with text confined to a top band, whereas B is entirely glyphic with no figures, plants or narrative imagery, and the sign forms themselves (rounded, rounded-square cartouche-like blocks versus fine wedge-like linear rows) follow different conventions.
